## History

Before arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a widower, Mr. Bentley had previously lost his wife. He served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years, though [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) found him lacking in imagination. In the preceding February, he resigned his charge and departed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) amid the regrets of his congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_
